school: 北宋'知识工程+制度稳定器'型宰相：以《武经总要》把一个王朝的军事知识第一次做成官修基础设施——奉敕授权取档案密度、统一分类收拢散落知识、器械图与文字互证、火药配方写成数字比例、历代战例按主题对读、成书后分层颁行天下；同时以'因革损益'的分层与四朝老成的政治信用，在变法启动的时刻为改革递出合法性的门票
historical_significance: 曾公亮（999-1078），字明仲，泉州晋江人，北宋真宗、仁宗、英宗、神宗四朝元老，官至枢密使、同中书门下平章事（宰相）；仁宗康定元年（1040）奉敕与丁度合编《武经总要》四十卷，历时数年成书，是中国历史上第一部官修军事百科全书——前集记制度、边防、阵法、器械，后集辑历代用兵故事；该书保存了世界现存最早的三个火药配方（毒药烟球、蒺藜火球、火炮火药法），收录床弩、楼船、城防等百余幅器械图，逐路记录宋辽、宋夏边防地理，成书后颁行武学、列为武举参考，南宋绍兴、绍圣间屡次重颁；为官四十余年'老成练达'（《宋史》本传），庆历至熙宁的党争起伏中稳居要职，晚年向神宗力荐王安石，为新法递出最初的政治合法性；神宗朝数请罢相，以太傅致仕；他证明：汇编可以是国家工程，守成可以是治理技术，而在制度的因与革之间，最稀缺的是那条明文的通道
historical_significance_en: Zeng Gongliang (999-1078), courtesy name Mingzhong, a native of Jinjiang in Quanzhou, served four reigns of the Northern Song — Zhenzong, Renzong, Yingzong, Shenzong — rising to military commissioner and chief councillor; in the first Kangding year (1040) he was commissioned with Ding Du to compile the Essentials of the Military Classics in forty scrolls, finished after several years — the first state-compiled military encyclopedia in Chinese history, the front collection on institutions, frontier, formations and engines, the rear gathering the campaigns of every dynasty; the book preserves the three earliest surviving gunpowder formulas in the world — the poison-smoke ball, the caltrop fireball, the cannon powder — carries over a hundred engine drawings, bed crossbows to city defenses, and records the frontier geography against Liao and Xia circuit by circuit; issued to the military academy, set for the military examinations, re-issued again and again under the Southern Song; in office forty years and more, 'seasoned and practicable' by the Song History's word, steady through the party strife from Qingli to Xining, in his last years urging Wang Anshi on Shenzong — handing the New Policies their first political legitimacy; he repeatedly asked to be relieved under Shenzong and retired as Grand Tutor; he proved that compilation can be a state project, that keeping can be a governable technology — and that between a制度's continuing and amending, the rarest thing is a written channel for each
unique_thinking: 曾公亮思维模式的独特性在于五条主线的合成：第一，'知识即基础设施'——《武经总要》的四要素（奉敕授权、统一分类、完整收录、制度性使用）把汇编从抄书升格为国家工程，半隐知识（军器图样、边防奏议）的收录是真正的壁垒；第二，'配方化'——把火药工艺写成数字比例与制法，让技术脱离对个别匠人的依赖，按用途派生变体而非万能配方；第三，'载体分层'——判断哪些知识本质上不是文字（方位、结构、比例），为它们造图这一专门载体，图文互证、按图可造；第四，'先例库外置判断力'——后集按主题而非编年辑历代战例、成败并收，让一个领域的判断力外化为可检索的案例库；第五，'因革分道'——前集记现行、后集辑历史，荐王安石而不主激进重建，把'延续'与'变革'各自放进明文的制度通道，以老成之身在最需要的时刻定向释放政治信用；五线共同指向一件事：让知识可传承、让变革有边界、让稳定有功能
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Zeng Gongliang's thinking is a synthesis of five lines. First, knowledge as infrastructure — the four elements of the Essentials, commission, classification, completeness, institutional use, raising compilation from copying to state engineering, the half-hidden knowledge of armory drawings and border memorials the true moat. Second, the formula — gunpowder craft written as numbers and method, freeing technique from individual artisans, variants derived by use rather than one universal recipe. Third, the layering of carriers — judging which knowledge is essentially non-textual, position, structure, proportion, and building the diagram as its dedicated carrier, text and image verifying each other, buildable from the sheet. Fourth, judgment externalized as precedent — the rear collection by theme, not chronicle, success and failure together, a field's judgment made a retrievable case library. Fifth, the parted channels of continue and amend — the front collection current, the rear historical, recommending Wang Anshi while leading no radical rebuilding, continuity and change each given a written institutional channel, the seasoned elder releasing his political credit, directed, at the moment of greatest need. The five lines share one direction: knowledge made transmissible, change given its boundary, stability given its function
civilization_zh: 十一世纪的北宋汴京——仁宗朝的文治里，一位四朝老臣在翰林院与政事堂之间往返：康定年间西陲烽警，曾公亮奉敕与丁度编次兵书，四十卷《武经总要》把一个王朝的军事知识第一次收拢成官修的百科——山川城寨逐路成表，床弩火器按图可造，火药配方第一次被写成数字，历代战例按主题对读；书成之后颁行武学、颁给边将，成了武举的课业与边防的依据；而他自己依旧'老成练达'，不结党、不慕奇，在王安石变法起步时以荐贤递出变法的门票，又在巅峰时请罢归第——这是一个知识工程师兼稳定器的世纪：他证明守成可以是工程，汇编可以是战略，而在制度的因与革之间，需要有人为两者各修一条明文的通道
civilization_en: Bianliang, the Northern Song, the eleventh century — in the civil splendor of Renzong's reign an elder of four reigns went between the Hanlin Academy and the Council: in the Kangding years, with alarms on the western marches, Zeng Gongliang was commissioned with Ding Du to put the military canon in order, and the forty scrolls of the Essentials of the Military Classics gathered a dynasty's military knowledge into an official encyclopedia for the first time — mountains and fortresses tabulated circuit by circuit, crossbows and fire engines buildable from their sheets, the gunpowder formulas written as numbers for the first time, the campaigns of every age read side by side by theme; completed, the book was issued to the military academy and the border commanders, the coursework of the examinations and the warrant of the frontier; and he himself stayed 'seasoned and practicable' — no faction, no fondness for the striking deed — passing the ticket of reform with his recommendation as Wang Anshi's New Policies began, and asking leave at his height; it was the century of an engineer of knowledge who was also a stabilizer: he proved that keeping can be engineering, compilation strategy — and that between a制度's continuing and amending someone must build each a written channel

cross_references.description_zh: 曾公亮与苏颂同为'知识做成长期资产'的北宋实践者，且同为闽人：苏颂以《新仪象法要》的全图让水运仪象台在书里活过王朝，曾公亮以《武经总要》的图说与配方让军事技术在纸上穿越时代；两人都相信'按图可造'是知识对抗时间的最高形态；差异在于苏颂的档案为复造一台机器，曾公亮的档案为运转一个体系。
cross_references.description_en: Zeng Gongliang and Su Song, both men of Fujian, are the Northern Song's two practitioners of making knowledge into a long-lived asset: Su Song's full drawings of the Essentials of the New Instrument let the water-driven orrery live past the dynasty inside a book; Zeng's diagrams and formulas of the Military Essentials let military craft cross its age on paper; both held 'buildable from the sheet' the highest form of knowledge against time; the difference: Su Song's archive serves to rebuild one machine, Zeng's to run a whole system.

cross_references.description_zh: 曾公亮与董仲舒代表知识工程的两种方向：董仲舒为宇宙人事立一套解释体系（天人感应），知识的功能是'赋予秩序以意义'；曾公亮为边防军政造一套操作体系（武经总要），知识的功能是'让行动可以执行'；一个向上建构形而上，一个向下建构可执行；对照命题：一个文明既需要解释世界的体系，也需要能照着做的手册——两种知识工程缺一则另一面落空。
cross_references.description_en: Zeng Gongliang and Dong Zhongshu mark two directions of knowledge engineering: Dong built for the cosmos and human affairs an explanatory system, the resonance of heaven and man — knowledge to give order its meaning; Zeng built for defense and administration an operating system, the Military Essentials — knowledge to make action executable; one building upward into the metaphysical, one downward into the workable; the contrast: a civilization needs both a system that explains the world and a manual one can work by — lacking either, the other falls empty.

cross_references.description_zh: 曾公亮与张载同处一个时代、同受'经世'传统的滋养，却各选一条路：张载为价值世界立恒常秩序（为天地立心），曾公亮为行动世界立恒常载体（为兵事立典）；两人都相信知识必须超越个人生命才有效力；差异在于张载的知识为了教化人心，曾公亮的知识为了运转制度。
cross_references.description_en: Zeng Gongliang and Zhang Zai, men of one age nourished by the same tradition of statecraft, took two roads: Zhang Zai founded a constant order for the world of value — setting the heart for heaven and earth; Zeng founded a constant carrier for the world of action — giving war its canon; both held knowledge effective only beyond a single life; the difference: Zhang Zai's knowledge to form hearts, Zeng's to run institutions.

cross_references.description_zh: 曾公亮与祖庚同为'制度存续'的实践者，方向互补：祖庚以甲骨刻辞让决策穿越三千年，靠的是载体的不可变与程序的恒定；曾公亮以颁行制度让知识传遍天下，靠的是分发的通道与版本的权威；一个把知识埋进土里等待后人，一个把知识发到天下交给当世；对照命题：知识的存续需要两条相反的腿——不可变的深藏与主动的散布。
cross_references.description_en: Zeng Gongliang and Zu Geng both served the survival of institutions, in complementary directions: Zu Geng's carved bones carried decisions three thousand years by the immutability of the carrier and the constancy of procedure; Zeng's issuing system carried knowledge across the realm by the channel of distribution and the authority of the recension; one buried knowledge in the earth for later men, one sent it out to the world of the living; the contrast: knowledge's survival needs two opposite legs — the unalterable hoard and the active spread.

modes.name_en: The Method of the Compiled Military Compendium
modes.category: 认知方法/系统性知识汇编
modes.domain_zh: 曾公亮一生最重的作品是《武经总要》：仁宗景祐—康定年间奉敕与丁度合编，历时数年成书四十卷，是中国历史上第一部官修军事百科全书；它的方法可以拆开看：第一，'奉敕'——知识汇编由国家立项，编者享有调用官方档案、军器监图样、边防奏议的权限，私人著述永远拿不到这种资料密度；第二，'总要'——不是抄书而是收束，把散在典籍、奏章、图谱里的军事知识按制度、边防、阵法、器械、医方分类收拢成可检索的体系；第三，'全'——从选将料兵到攻城守具到医方与地名考，把一个领域的全部显知识与官府半隐知识一次收录；第四，'存'——书成之后藏于官府、颁于武学，北宋兵制随后的每一次讨论都要回到这部书；他证明：一个领域的知识只有在'官方授权+统一分类+完整收录+制度性使用'四个条件齐备时，才第一次成为可传承的国家资产——汇编不是抄书，是把散落的知识做成基础设施
modes.domain_en: Zeng Gongliang's heaviest work was the Essentials of the Military Classics: commissioned by Emperor Renzong, compiled with Ding Du over several years into forty scrolls — China's first state-compiled military encyclopedia. Its method comes apart into four pieces. First, the imperial commission: the compilation was a state project, giving the editors access to official archives, armory drawings and border memorials — a density of material no private author ever touched. Second, 'essentials': not copying but gathering — scattering knowledge from classics, memorials and diagrams, sorted by institutions, frontier defense, formations, engines and medicine into a searchable order. Third, completeness: from selecting generals and weighing troops to siege engines and place-name verification, the whole explicit knowledge of a field and the government's half-hidden knowledge taken in at once. Fourth, preservation: completed, the book was kept in government and issued to the military academy; every later Song debate on the army returned to it. He proved that a field's knowledge first becomes a transmissible state asset when four conditions meet — official authorization, unified classification, complete collection, institutional use; compilation is not copying, it is making scattered knowledge into infrastructure
modes.source_chapter: 《武经总要》前集二十卷、后集二十卷（曾公亮、丁度奉敕编，成书约1044年）；《宋史·曾公亮传》载'奉诏编次兵书'
modes.key_quote_zh: 汇编不是抄书，是把散落的知识做成基础设施——官方授权、统一分类、完整收录、制度性使用，四者齐备知识才第一次成为国家资产
modes.key_quote_en: "Compilation is not copying but making scattered knowledge into infrastructure — only with authorization, classification, completeness and institutional use does knowledge first become a state asset."
process_zh: 争取最高授权：把汇编立项为国家级工程（奉敕），取得调用官府档案与图样的权限——资料的密度决定汇编的上限
先建分类骨架再填内容：按'制度—边防—阵法—器械—医方'等一级类目立框架，一切材料先归类后录用——没有骨架的汇编是资料堆
收录'半隐知识'：不仅抄典籍，更收录军器监图样、边防奏议、老兵口传等官府内部知识——显知识人人可见，半隐知识才是壁垒
让书进入制度：编成后藏于官府、颁于武学、成为后世决策的引用标准——无人使用的汇编只是书架上的死物
process_en: Win the highest authorization: make the compilation a state project (imperial commission) with access to government archives and drawings — the density of material sets the ceiling of the compilation

Build the skeleton of categories before filling: erect first-level classes — institutions, frontier, formations, engines, medicine — and sort every item before accepting it; a compilation without a skeleton is a heap

Collect the half-hidden knowledge: beyond the classics, take in the armory's drawings, the border memorials, the veterans' oral knowledge — explicit knowledge is seen by all; the half-hidden is the moat
Put the book into institutions: kept in government, issued to the academy, cited as the standard in later decisions — an unused compilation is a dead thing on a shelf
representative_cases_zh: 《武经总要》的立项逻辑：康定年间西夏战事吃紧，仁宗命曾公亮、丁度编次兵书——国家在战争中启动知识工程，把应急需求转成永久资产
四十卷的类目体系：全书分前集（制度、边防、阵法、器械）、后集（故事、医方、占候）——一个军事领域的全部知识被一次切分收拢，后世武举以它为教科书
军器图样的收录：书中收录大量兵器、城防器械的图样与尺寸——官方图档第一次进入公开文本，私人工匠与将官从此共享同一份图纸
representative_cases_en: The commissioning logic: with the war against Xi Xia pressing in the Kangding years, Renzong ordered Zeng Gongliang and Ding Du to compile the military canon — a state launching a knowledge project in wartime, turning an emergency into a permanent asset

The taxonomy of forty scrolls: front collection (institutions, frontier, formations, engines) and rear collection (cases, medicine, divination) — a whole military field cut and gathered at once, later the textbook of the military examinations
The inclusion of armory drawings: figures and dimensions of weapons and siege gear taken into an open text for the first time — private craftsmen and field officers now shared one set of sheets
modern_applications_zh: 组织知识库的'四条件'审计：检查组织的文档体系是否同时具备官方授权、统一分类、完整收录、制度性使用——缺任何一条，知识库都只是文件夹
把'半隐知识'写进汇编：设计规范、事故复盘、老师傅的口诀这类不进文档的内部知识，必须有人负责收录——壁垒不在显知识里
大项目的'骨架先行'：动笔前先定一级类目并冻结，材料按骨架归位——曾公亮的类目让四十卷互不重叠，也让你的一万条笔记可以检索
modern_applications_en: The four-condition audit of a knowledge base: check whether the organization's documentation has authorization, classification, completeness and institutional use at once — missing any one, the base is just folders

Write the half-hidden knowledge in: design rules, incident reviews, the old hand's mnemonics — knowledge that never enters documents must have an owner charged with collecting it; the moat is not in the explicit

Skeleton first on big projects: freeze the top-level categories before writing, and file every item to the skeleton — Zeng's categories kept forty scrolls from overlapping, and can keep ten thousand notes searchable

modes.name_en: The Method of the Gunpowder Formula
modes.category: 方法论/把经验工艺标准化为可复制配方
modes.domain_zh: 《武经总要》前集保存了世界现存最早的三个火药配方（毒药烟球、蒺藜火球、火炮火药），各配方给出成分、比例与制法——这是人类第一次把一项尖端军事技术从师徒口传写成可复制的标准文件；这个动作的深意在于：第一，配方化——把'几分硝、几分硫、几分炭'写成数字比例，工艺就脱离了对个别匠人的依赖；第二，分级化——三个配方对应三种武器用途，同一底层技术按场景派生变体，而非一个万能配方；第三，公开化——配方写进官修颁行的书里，意味着技术主权从个别工匠转移到国家档案；第四，附注化——配比旁边附毒烟、蒺藜等弹体设计，技术与战术一起归档；他证明：一项技术的真正成熟，不在于有人会用，而在于它被写成任何人按方可制的标准文件——配方是技术的成人礼
modes.domain_en: The front collection of the Essentials preserves the three earliest surviving gunpowder formulas in the world — the poison-smoke ball, the caltrop fireball, the cannon powder — each giving ingredients, proportions and method: the first time a cutting-edge military technology was written from master-apprentice transmission into a reproducible standard document. The depth of the act: first, formula — writing parts of saltpeter, sulfur and charcoal as numeric proportion frees the craft from dependence on individual artisans; second, grading — three formulas for three weapon uses, one base technology deriving variants by scenario instead of one universal formula; third, publication — formulas in a state-compiled, state-issued book means technological sovereignty moved from individual artisans to the state archive; fourth, annotation — beside each ratio the ball's design, poison smoke or caltrop, so technique and tactics archive together. He proved: a technology is truly mature not when someone can use it but when it is written as a standard file anyone can follow — the formula is a technology's coming of age

modes.key_quote_zh: 一项技术的真正成熟，不在于有人会用，而在于它被写成任何人按方可制的标准文件——配方是技术的成人礼
modes.key_quote_en: "A technology is mature not when someone can use it but when it is written as a standard file anyone can follow — the formula is a technology's coming of age."
process_zh: 把工艺翻译成数字配方：成分、份数、次序逐项写明——凡是还在'凭手感'的环节，都标注为未完成标准化的部分
按用途派生变体而非造万能配方：同一底层技术为不同场景（烟幕、撒刺、抛射）各配一版——标准化的成熟形态是家族而非单体
把配方从个人手里收进组织档案：技术主权随文档化从个人转移给组织——留一手的匠人是风险，不是资产
配方与用法一起归档：写明配比同时写明弹体设计与投放场景——脱离战术的配方在下一代人手里只剩数字
process_en: Translate craft into numeric formula: ingredients, parts and order written item by item — whatever still runs 'by feel' is marked as not yet standardized
Derive variants by use, not one universal formula: one base technology, a version per scenario — smoke, caltrops, projection; the mature form of standardization is a family, not a monolith

Move the formula from persons into the organization's archive: with documentation, sovereignty in the technology passes from individuals to the organization — the artisan who keeps a trick in reserve is a risk, not an asset
Archive formula with usage: beside the ratios, the ball's design and delivery scenario — a formula divorced from tactics is only numbers in the next generation's hands

毒药烟球的成分设计：火药之外加草乌头、巴豆、狼毒等毒物——配方文档同时记录'如何致效'的完整因果链，而非只给易燃物清单
蒺藜火球的结构附注：铁蒺藜布置、壳体层数、引信位置随配方附图——一处配方文件覆盖成分、结构、用法三层
representative_cases_en: The cannon powder ratio: forty parts saltpeter, fourteen sulfur, fourteen charcoal plus fillers — a nitrate share far above earlier recipes, showing that formula-writing itself drove the craft's iteration

The caltrop ball's structural notes: caltrop placement, shell layers, fuse position appended to the recipe — one formula file covering composition, structure and use

配方与用法同库：每个标准文件附'何时用、怎么投、预期效果'——没有场景注释的SOP在新人手里必然变形
modern_applications_en: Formula-ize core craft: write the process living only in one head — deployment steps, tuning hands — as ingredient, parts and order; whatever cannot be written is the organization's single point of failure
Family-style documents, standard plus variants: one process, a maintained variant per scenario — sale days, daily, emergency — closer to reality than one universal SOP
Formula and usage in one place: every standard file carries when to use, how to deliver, expected effect — an SOP without scenario notes deforms in a newcomer's hands

modes.name_en: The Method of Diagram and Text Together
modes.category: 方法论/以图谱承载文字不能承载的知识
modes.domain_zh: 《武经总要》收录了百余幅器械图：楼船、云梯、床弩、城防布局、阵图皆有图样，图文对照——在那个几乎全靠文字传承的时代，曾公亮团队做了一个决定性的判断：军事知识有一半是空间性的，文字写不下来；阵法的妙处在方位关系，器械的妙处在结构比例，这些只能画。配图不是装饰而是必要组件：第一，图把'看一眼就懂、说三天说不清'的知识钉进纸面；第二，图与文互相校验——文字记尺寸，图记形状，两者对得上才算可信；第三，图让远地的人无需亲见实物即可仿制——一张床弩图就是一份传输协议；他证明：知识体系设计的第一步是判断'哪些知识本质上不是文字'，然后为它们造专门的载体——拒绝为非文字知识造载体的体系，注定只传承文字能承载的那一半
modes.domain_en: The Essentials carries over a hundred engine diagrams: tower ships, scaling ladders, bed crossbows, city defenses, formation charts, each with its text — in an age transmitting nearly everything by writing, Zeng Gongliang's team made a decisive judgment: half of military knowledge is spatial and cannot be written down. The genius of a formation lives in relations of position, the genius of an engine in structural proportion — only drawn. The diagrams were not decoration but necessary components: first, the diagram pins to paper the knowledge that is seen in one glance and beyond three days of telling; second, diagram and text check each other — the words record dimensions, the picture the shape, and credible only when they agree; third, the diagram lets a distant man copy what he has never seen — one crossbow drawing is a transmission protocol. He proved: the first step in designing a knowledge system is judging which knowledge is essentially non-textual, then building a dedicated carrier for it — a system refusing carriers for non-textual knowledge inherits only the half that text can hold
modes.source_chapter: 《武经总要》前集收录器械图百余幅：床弩、楼船、云梯、拐子马阵图、城制图等；图注标尺寸与部件名
modes.key_quote_zh: 知识体系设计的第一步是判断哪些知识本质上不是文字，然后为它们造专门的载体
modes.key_quote_en: "The first step of a knowledge system is judging which knowledge is essentially non-textual, then building a dedicated carrier for it."
process_zh: 盘点领域知识的载体需求：逐类判断'文字能否承载'——方位、结构、比例、形态类的知识默认不能，必须配图
定图例与标注规范：部件名、尺寸、比例尺统一标注——没有统一图例的图，跨人不可读
图文互证：文字记参数、图记关系，两套记录交叉校验——单一载体错了无人知晓，双载体错了当场暴露
按图可造为验收标准：判断一张图合格的标准是'异地的工匠照图能否造出'——不可仿制的图只是画
process_en: Inventory the carrier needs of the field: judge category by category whether text can carry it — position, structure, proportion and form default to no, and must be drawn
Fix the conventions of legend and annotation: part names, dimensions, scale uniform — a drawing without uniform legend is unreadable across persons
Let diagram and text verify each other: words for parameters, picture for relations, two records cross-checked — a single carrier fails silently, a double fails loudly
Take 'buildable from the sheet' as acceptance: a drawing qualifies when a distant artisan can build from it — a drawing that cannot be copied is only a painting
representative_cases_zh: 床弩图的部件标注：三弓床弩图上张机、弩床、矢道各部件有名字有位置——后人据图复原出三弓床弩的装填方式
城制图的等级序列：从都城到州县各级城池的形制按等级画列——城市防御知识第一次有了可对照的规范图集
阵图的方位编码：八阵图、常阵图以方位+番号标示各部位置——'进退分合'这类纯空间知识被压缩进一页纸
representative_cases_en: The labeled parts of the bed crossbow: on the three-bow engine's drawing, winch, bed and bolt channel each named and placed — later restorers read the loading method from the sheet itself
The graded sequence of city plans: capitals to prefecture towns drawn by rank — urban defense knowledge had its first comparable standard atlas
The positional encoding of formation charts: the eight formations marked by direction and unit number — pure spatial knowledge of advance, retreat, splitting and joining pressed onto one page
modern_applications_zh: 文档体系的'载体审计'：列出团队知识清单，逐项标注'文字/图/表格/代码'——长期只有文字载体的知识域（架构、流程、拓扑）补齐图形载体
架构图的'异地可造'验收：一张架构图合格的标准是异地团队照图不问原作者即可搭出系统——做不到就回炉
双载体交叉校验：关键设计同时维护'参数表+示意图'，两者对不上立即触发评审——单一载体是静默错误的温床
modern_applications_en: A carrier audit of documentation: list the team's knowledge and mark each item text, diagram, table or code — knowledge domains long text-only, such as architecture, process, topology, get graphical carriers added
The 'buildable elsewhere' test for architecture diagrams: a diagram qualifies when a remote team can stand up the system from it without asking the author; failing that, back to the board
Dual-carrier cross-check: key designs keep both a parameter table and a schematic; any mismatch triggers review at once — a single carrier is a hothouse of silent errors

modes.name_en: The Method of Continuing and Amending
modes.category: 方法论/制度变革的'因'与'革'分层
modes.domain_zh: 《武经总要》后集的编法暴露了曾公亮对制度变革的真实看法：全书前集记当代现行制度，后集辑历代用兵故事——'因'与'革'被放进同一部书里对照；他自己为官数十年，历真宗、仁宗、英宗、神宗四朝，身居相位而不主持激进的制度重建，却在王安石变法中推荐了王安石——变法的点火者由守成的老臣亲手推举；这个姿态是一种分层技术：第一，哪些该'因'——防务体系、文官运作、祖宗成法中仍有效的部分，原样续用；第二，哪些该'革'——经他确认失效的部分（他晚年向神宗称王安石'真辅相之才'，即承认旧法之外的补充必要）；第三，变革由合法程序进行——推荐而非私议，让'革'本身也有制度通道；他证明：变革最大的风险不是变，而是变与不变的边界失控——成熟的政治是让'因'与'革'各有一条明文的通道
modes.domain_en: The compilation of the rear collection betrays Zeng Gongliang's true view of institutional change: the front collection records the institutions in force, the rear collection gathers the campaigns of every dynasty — 'continuing' and 'amending' set side by side in one book. Serving decades across four reigns, a chief councillor who led no radical rebuilding, he yet recommended Wang Anshi in the New Policies — the spark of reform proposed by the old hand of continuity. The stance is a layering technique: first, what to continue — the defense system, the civil operation, the parts of ancestral law still working, taken over whole; second, what to amend — the parts he judged failed, his late word to Shenzong that Wang Anshi had 'the talent of a true chancellor' admitting the need for additions beyond the old law; third, change by lawful procedure — recommended, not schemed, so that amendment itself has an institutional channel. He proved the greatest risk of change is not changing but the boundary between change and no-change running wild — mature politics gives 'continue' and 'amend' each a written channel
modes.source_chapter: 《宋史·曾公亮传》：'公亮老成练达'，荐王安石于神宗；《武经总要》前集记当朝制度、后集辑历代故事的分编结构
modes.key_quote_zh: 变革最大的风险不是变，而是变与不变的边界失控——成熟的政治是让'因'与'革'各有一条明文的通道
modes.key_quote_en: "The greatest risk of change is not changing but the boundary between change and no-change running wild — mature politics gives continuing and amending each a written channel."
process_zh: 把制度资产分成'因'与'革'两栏：逐项判断'继续有效/已经失效'，两栏都明文列出——不列清单的变革必然误伤
'因'的部分公开捍卫：对仍有效的旧制公开说明其价值并续用——老臣的价值在于为不该动的部分提供合法性
'革'的部分走合法通道：需要变革时通过荐人、议事、上疏等程序推进——私议变法是动乱之源
让新旧并置供后人对照：像前集后集一样，把现行制度与历史案例收进同一体系——后代变革者因此知道自己从哪里变到哪里
process_en: Sort institutional assets into 'continue' and 'amend': judge item by item 'still working / already failed,' both columns written down — change without a list wounds blindly
Defend the 'continue' column openly: state the worth of the working old system and keep it — the old statesman's value is legitimacy for what must not move
Route the 'amend' column through lawful channels: advance change by recommending men, deliberating, memorializing — private scheming for reform is the wellspring of disorder

Set new and old side by side for posterity: as front and rear collections, keep current institutions and historical cases in one system — later reformers then know where they start and where they head
representative_cases_zh: 荐王安石：曾公亮晚年向神宗力荐王安石为相——最资深的守成者亲手递出变法的入场券，变法因此获得它原本没有的合法性
前集后集的分编：现行制度与历代战例同书并置——读者被迫同时面对'我们现在怎样'与'历来怎样'，变与不变失去情绪化的土壤
四朝不倒的仕途：真宗至神宗四朝任职而位至宰相——不站队激进派或保守派任何一方，只认'因革分层'这道工序
representative_cases_en: Recommending Wang Anshi: in his last years Zeng urged Shenzong to make Wang Anshi chancellor — the most senior keeper of continuity handing reform its ticket, lending the New Policies a legitimacy they lacked

Front and rear collections: current institutions and historical campaigns in one book — the reader forced to face both 'how we do now' and 'how it ever was,' and change versus no-change losing its emotional soil

Four reigns without fall: office from Zhenzong to Shenzong to the chancellorship — aligned with neither the radical nor the conservative camp, loyal only to the procedure of layering continue and amend
modern_applications_zh: 接手组织时的'两栏清单'：把现有制度逐项归入'继续有效'与'已经失效'两栏并公之于众——变革提案必须指明要动哪一栏的哪一项
老臣的'合法性供给'角色：资深成员最有价值的动作不是主持创新，而是为该保留的东西公开背书、为该变的通过合法程序递票
新旧并置的制度档案：每次重大变革前，把现行制度与历史对照案例放进同一份文档——变与不变从此有据可查
modern_applications_en: The two-column list on taking over: file every existing institution into 'still working' and 'already failed,' published — every reform proposal must name which column, which item it touches
The senior's role of supplying legitimacy: the senior member's most valuable act is not leading innovation but publicly endorsing what to keep and passing the ticket lawfully for what to change
An institutional archive with old and new side by side: before every major change, current institutions and comparative history in one document — change and no-change henceforth on the record

modes.name_en: The Method of the Frontier Situation
modes.category: 认知方法/地理—军政情报的结构化整合
modes.domain_zh: 《武经总要》前集用了大量篇幅做一件看似枯燥的事：逐路记录边防地理——北边辽、西北夏、西南蛮各路的山川、关隘、城寨、驻军、道路，一一对齐成表；这背后的认知模式是：战略判断的前提不是'知道很多信息'，而是把信息按'地理为骨架、军事为血肉'的结构装配起来——第一，地理骨架先行：先画山川关隘的固定框架，再往里填驻军与兵力，因为地形百年不变而驻军岁岁轮换，骨架必须比数据更稳定；第二，敌方与我方同表对齐：辽军从哪条路入侵、我军在哪座城设防，攻防两方的信息放同一张表上，缺口自己显形；第三，'形势'优先于'事件'：记录的不是某次战役，而是长期的攻防态势——事件会过期，形势不会；他证明：情报工作的成品不是一堆消息，而是一张持续更新的形势底图——底图对了，任何新消息都能立刻放对位置
modes.domain_en: The front collection spends long scrolls on a seemingly dry task: recording frontier geography circuit by circuit — against Liao in the north, Xia in the northwest, the tribes of the southwest — mountains, passes, fortresses, garrisons and roads aligned into tables. The cognition beneath: the premise of strategic judgment is not knowing much but assembling information on the frame of geography with the military as flesh. First, the geographic skeleton first: the fixed frame of mountains and passes drawn, then garrisons filled in — terrain does not shift in a century while garrisons rotate yearly; the frame must be steadier than the data. Second, enemy and self aligned on one table: by which road Liao invades, at which fortress we defend — both sides' information on the same sheet, and the gaps show themselves. Third, 'situation' over 'events': what is recorded is not a battle but the long posture of offense and defense — events expire, situations do not. He proved: the product of intelligence work is not a pile of messages but a continuously updated situation base-map — with the base-map right, any new message finds its place at once
modes.source_chapter: 《武经总要》前集卷十六上之下：河北路、河东路、陕西路、成都路、荆湖北路等诸路边防各卷，记山川、城寨、军马、道路
modes.key_quote_zh: 情报工作的成品不是一堆消息，而是一张持续更新的形势底图——底图对了，任何新消息都能立刻放对位置
modes.key_quote_en: "The product of intelligence is not a pile of messages but a continuously updated situation base-map — with the base-map right, any new message finds its place at once."
process_zh: 先立稳定的骨架：选变化最慢的维度（地理、组织架构）做底图框架——骨架的寿命必须长于数据的寿命
把对手与我方放进同一坐标系：攻防两侧的信息按同一表结构记录——分开记录的情报永远对不齐
记录形势而非流水账：按'长期态势'而非'单次事件'组织记录——事件的保质期以天计，形势以年计
定期回填与修订：骨架不动、数据按季更新——一张十年不更新的底图比没有底图更危险
process_en: Erect the stable skeleton first: choose the slowest-changing dimension — geography, org structure — as the base frame; the skeleton must outlive the data
Put opponent and self in one coordinate system: both sides' information in the same table structure — intelligence recorded apart can never be aligned
Record situations, not chronicles: organize by long posture, not single events — an event's shelf life is days, a situation's years
Backfill and revise on schedule: skeleton fixed, data refreshed by the quarter — a base-map ten years stale is more dangerous than none
representative_cases_zh: 河北路的边防卷：对辽前线的州军、塘泊、道路逐项列表——澶渊之盟后宋辽百年和平，靠的正是这种'形势底图'让双方边界态势透明可核
陕西路对夏布防：堡寨链、粮道、马源按地理骨架装配——西夏的入侵路线被预置在图上，宋军的每座城寨知道自己在整个链条中的位置
塘泊防线的设计：利用河北洼地连片蓄水为障碍——把'地理'直接当武器用的前提，是先有一张足够准的水文底图
representative_cases_en: The Hebei frontier scroll: prefectures, garrisons, marshes and roads of the Liao front tabulated — the century of peace after Chanyuan rested on such a base-map making the border posture transparent and checkable to both sides

The Shaanxi deployment against Xia: fort chains, grain roads and horse sources assembled on the geographic frame — Xia's invasion routes pre-plotted, every Song fortress knowing its place in the whole chain
The marsh-defense design: flooding the Hebei lowlands into a continuous barrier — using geography itself as a weapon presupposed a hydrographic base-map accurate enough
modern_applications_zh: 竞争情报的'底图化'：为竞争对手维护一张固定骨架的形势表（产品线×市场×能力），新消息一律回填进格子里——消息流变成态势图
基础设施依赖审计：把自家系统架在'变化最慢的维度'上（协议、标准、地理冗余），而非架在易变的服务上——骨架比数据长寿
攻防同表：安全团队把'我们的暴露面'与'攻击者的路径'放同一张表——分开维护的两份情报永远拼不出缺口
modern_applications_en: The base-map of competitive intelligence: keep a fixed-frame situation table of rivals — product lines by market by capability — and backfill every new message into its cell; the message stream becomes a posture map
The audit of infrastructural dependence: stand your systems on the slowest-changing dimensions — protocols, standards, geographic redundancy — not on volatile services; the skeleton outlives the data
Attack and defense on one table: the security team keeps our exposure and the attacker's paths in the same sheet — two separately kept intelligences never assemble into a gap

modes.name_en: The Method of Weering the Engine to Its Use
modes.category: 方法论/以作战需求牵引器械设计
modes.domain_zh: 《武经总要》记器械从不孤立记物：每一种兵器都写明'用于何处、如何操作、配多少兵'——床弩记张设之法与守城之用，火器记施放次序与风势之宜，攻械记对城之策；这个编排原则背后是一个工程认知：器械的价值不在其巧，而在其与战术体系的咬合——第一，需求倒推设计：先写'要解决什么作战问题'，再写器械结构，读者因此明白每个部件为何存在；第二，操作入册：器械的用法（几人张设、几步施放）与器械本身同页记录——脱离操作的设计图只是摆设；第三，体系配套：每件器械标注它与城防、阵法的配合关系——单品再精良，不能咬进体系就是废物；他证明：工程设计的第一问不是'能不能造出来'，而是'它嵌在哪个使用系统里'——为体系造物，不为造物造物
modes.domain_en: The Essentials never records an engine alone: every weapon states where it serves, how it is worked, and with how many men — the bed crossbow with its tensioning and its defense of walls, the fire weapons their order of discharge and their need of wind, the siege gear their answer to the wall. Behind the arrangement is an engineering cognition: the worth of an engine lies not in its cleverness but in its bite with the tactical system. First, design pulled back from need: the combat problem stated before the structure, so the reader learns why each part exists. Second, operation in the register: the use — how many men to tension, how many paces to discharge — on the same page as the machine; a design sheet divorced from operation is an ornament. Third, systemic pairing: each engine marked for its fit with walls and formations — however fine in itself, what cannot bite into a system is scrap. He proved the first question of engineering design is not 'can it be built' but 'which system of use does it embed in' — build for the system, not for the thing
modes.source_chapter: 《武经总要》前集卷十至卷十三器械诸卷：床弩、火器、攻城器械各条均记形制、用法、兵力配置
modes.key_quote_zh: 工程设计的第一问不是能不能造出来，而是它嵌在哪个使用系统里——为体系造物，不为造物造物
modes.key_quote_en: "The first question of design is not 'can it be built' but 'which system of use does it embed in' — build for the system, not for the thing."
process_zh: 先写问题再写方案：每件设计文档第一行写明'此物解决什么作战问题'——不能一句话说清用途的设计直接淘汰
操作与结构同册：设计文档必须包含人力、步骤、场地等操作参数——只画结构不写操作，等于交付半件产品
标注体系接口：写明此器械与哪些城防、阵法、补给环节衔接——接口不明的器械无法编入作战序列
以体系验收单品：器械合格的标准不是试验场表现，而是编入现行战术体系后是否提升整体战力
process_en: State the problem before the scheme: line one of every design document names the combat problem solved; a design that cannot say its use in one sentence is cut at once
Operation and structure in one register: the design must carry its operating parameters — men, steps, ground; structure without operation delivers half a product
Mark the system interfaces: with which walls, formations and supply links the engine connects — an engine of unknown interfaces cannot enter the order of battle
Accept the single by the system: an engine qualifies not by proving-ground show but by whether, entered into the current tactics, it lifts the whole
representative_cases_zh: 床弩的守城定位：三弓床弩条目写明'凡守城拒敌，用之以退冲阵'——一件重器械的定位被锁死在守城战术里，而非泛称'威力大'
火器的风候条件：火药器械条目注明施放须看风势——把环境约束写进操作规程，是体系化用器的早期样本
攻械与守械成对编排：云梯、对楼等攻城械与撞竿、叉竿等守城械在卷中相对而列——一张卷页同时呈现攻防两方的技术对策
representative_cases_en: The bed crossbow's walled-post: the three-bow engine's entry reads 'against the assaulting column in the defense of walls' — a heavy engine's role locked into defense tactics, not a vague 'great power'
The fire weapons' wind conditions: the powder engines note that discharge waits on the wind — environment written into the operating rule, an early specimen of systemic gunnery
Attack and defense engines paired in the scroll: scaling ladders and siege towers facing the poles and forks that meet them — one page showing both sides' technical answers at once
modern_applications_zh: 设计文档的'问题行'制度：每份技术方案第一行写明解决什么问题、嵌在哪个系统——写不出问题行的工作不做
操作参数随架构交付：接口文档必须带容量、延迟、人手、故障演练等操作参数——纯结构文档视为未完成
以体系收益验收功能：新功能上线标准不是demo成功，而是编入现行工作流后整体指标是否改善
modern_applications_en: The 'problem line' rule of design docs: line one of every scheme names the problem and the system of use; work that cannot write its problem line is not done
Deliver operating parameters with the architecture: interface docs must carry capacity, latency, staffing, failure drills — structure-only docs count as unfinished
Accept features by systemic gain: the bar for shipping is not a demo but whether, entered into the current workflow, the whole metric improves

modes.name_en: The Method of Cases as Mirror
modes.category: 认知方法/以历史战例构建决策先例库
modes.domain_zh: 《武经总要》后集二十卷几乎全是'故事'——历代用兵的成败案例按主题分类：料兵、制胜、出奇、守险、粮道……每一个主题下面堆着从春秋到当代的战例；这个结构的隐含主张是：军事判断的主要依据不是理论推演，而是先例检索——遇到一个新局面，第一反应是'历史上谁遇到过类似局面、他怎么处理、结果如何'；第一，案例按主题而非按朝代编排：跨千年的案例被放进同一主题下对读，时间被折叠，可比性优先于编年；第二，成败并收：成功与失败的战例都收——先例库的价值一半在'照着做'，另一半在'别这么做'；第三，案例服务于分类而不淹没于分类：每条战例保持叙事完整，可读出当时人的完整决策链；他证明：一个领域的判断力可以外化为一个组织良好的案例库——判例法式的知识结构让后来者站在所有前人的肩膀上做决定
modes.domain_en: The rear collection of the Essentials is almost all 'cases' — campaigns of every dynasty sorted by theme: weighing troops, gaining victory, surprise, holding ground, grain roads — under each theme cases from the Spring and Autumn to the present. The hidden claim: the ground of military judgment is not deduction but retrieval of precedent — meeting a new situation, first asking who met its like, what he did, how it ended. First, cases arranged by theme, not dynasty: cases a millennium apart read side by side under one heading — time folded, comparability over chronology. Second, success and failure both kept: the precedent library's worth is half 'do as this' and half 'never as that'. Third, cases serve the scheme without drowning in it: each case keeps its story whole, the actors' full chain of decision still readable. He proved: a field's judgment can be externalized into a well-ordered case library — a common-law structure of knowledge lets latecomers decide from all their predecessors' shoulders
modes.source_chapter: 《武经总要》后集二十卷：分'料兵''制胜''出奇''守险'等主题辑历代战例，自春秋迄本朝
modes.key_quote_zh: 一个领域的判断力可以外化为一个组织良好的案例库——判例法式的知识结构让后来者站在所有前人的肩膀上做决定
modes.key_quote_en: "A field's judgment can be externalized into a well-ordered case library — a common-law structure lets latecomers decide from all their predecessors' shoulders."
process_zh: 先定主题类目再收案例：类目来自本领域真实会反复出现的决策情境（料兵、制胜、守险）——类目错则案例库不可用
跨时间归入同题：不同时代的同类案例放进同一主题对读——先例的可比性来自情境相似，不来自年代相近
成败两条腿收录：每个主题下成功案例与失败案例必须同时存在——只有成功案例的库是幸存者偏差展览馆
保持案例叙事完整：每条案例保留背景、决策、结果三段——被压缩成金句的案例失去可迁移性
process_en: Fix the thematic classes before gathering: classes from the decisions this field truly meets again and again — weighing troops, victory, holding ground; wrong classes make the library unusable
Fold time into one heading: like situations of different eras read side by side — precedent's comparability comes from likeness of situation, not nearness of date
Gather on two legs, success and failure: under every theme both must exist; a library of successes only is a museum of survivorship bias
Keep each case's story whole: background, decision, outcome in three parts — a case squeezed to an aphorism loses its transferability
representative_cases_zh: '制胜'主题的千年对读：韩信背水与王濬楼船同卷而列——两个相隔四百年的制胜案例被放进同一情境类目，读者被迫提炼超越时代的共同结构
失败战例的保留：后集收覆军、失地之败——失败案例与成功案例同一待遇，成为'别这么做'的负先例
案例保留完整决策链：每条战例写明当时情势、主将判断、执行与结局——后人可逐段追问'若我是主将会怎样'
representative_cases_en: The millennium reading of 'victory': Han Xin's backed-water and Wang Jun's tower ships in one scroll — cases four centuries apart under one heading, forcing the reader to distill a structure beyond its age
The keeping of failures: the rear collection holds routed armies and lost ground — failures given equal standing, negative precedents of 'never thus'
Cases with the whole decision chain: each campaign stating the situation, the general's judgment, the execution and the end — later readers may ask at every step, 'had I been the general?'
modern_applications_zh: 组织案例库的'主题先于编年'：复盘文档按决策情境分类（扩容决策、危机公关、关键招聘），不按季度归档——情境相似才是检索键
成败并收制度：每个主题下强制配对成功与失败案例——只晒胜利的组织案例库会系统性地误导新决策者
案例的'三段完整'标准：复盘必须写全背景、当时判断、实际结果——没有完整决策链的案例只是宣传材料
modern_applications_en: Theme before chronicle in the case library: post-mortems filed by decision situation — scaling calls, crisis PR, key hires — not by quarter; likeness of situation is the retrieval key
The paired-success rule: every theme must carry successes and failures together — a library of wins alone misleads every new decider systematically
The three-part wholeness bar: every post-mortem records background, the judgment at the time, the actual result — a case without its decision chain is only publicity

modes.definition_en: The rear collection of the Essentials is almost all 'cases' — campaigns of every dynasty sorted by theme: weighing troops, gaining victory, surprise, holding ground, grain roads — under each theme cases from the Spring and Autumn to the present. The hidden claim: the ground of military judgment is not deduction but retrieval of precedent — meeting a new situation, first asking who met its like, what he did, how it ended. First, cases arranged by theme, not dynasty: cases a millennium apart read side by side under one heading — time folded, comparability over chronology. Second, success and failure both kept: the precedent library's worth is half 'do as this' and half 'never as that'. Third, cases serve the scheme without drowning in it: each case keeps its story whole, the actors' full chain of decision still readable. He proved: a field's judgment can be externalized into a well-ordered case library — a common-law structure of knowledge lets latecomers decide from all their predecessors' shoulders

modes.name_en: The Method of the Paired Compilation
modes.category: 组织与权力/大型工程的双主编制衡结构
modes.domain_zh: 《武经总要》署曾公亮、丁度两名：曾公亮时任翰林学士、后为宰相，主总纲与军政资源；丁度精通音韵训诂、久任书局，主文本考订——一军政、一文翰，双人共同署名一部四十卷的书；这个编制安排是一种组织技术：第一，能力互补而非分工重叠：两个主编的能力域不重叠，主编之间天然形成校验而非竞争；第二，署名共担：两人同署即共担成书质量，谁也无法把失误推给对方；第三，跨系统接入：军政主编打通边防奏议与军器档案，文翰主编打通典籍考据——一部书因此同时接入两个知识系统；第四，进度可控：双主编互为对方的后备，一人病故或调任书局不停摆；他证明：大型知识工程的可靠性设计，从主编架构开始——单人主编是最常见的单点故障
modes.domain_en: The Essentials bears two names, Zeng Gongliang and Ding Du: Zeng then a Hanlin academician and later chancellor, holding the general scheme and the military-political resources; Ding Du master of phonology and exegesis, long in the compilation office, holding textual verification — one military-political, one literary, sharing the signature of forty scrolls. The arrangement is organizational technology: first, complementary not overlapping competence — two editors whose domains do not overlap check each other by nature instead of competing; second, shared signature: both names carry the book's quality, and neither can push a fault to the other; third, access to two systems: the military-political editor opens the border memorials and armory archives, the literary editor opens the classics and philology — one book wired into two knowledge systems at once; fourth, controllable progress: each editor the other's backup — one falls ill or is transferred, the office does not stop. He proved: the reliability engineering of a great knowledge project begins with the architecture of its editors — the single chief editor is the commonest single point of failure
modes.source_chapter: 《武经总要》进书表署'曾公亮、丁度'；《宋史·丁度传》：'度好学，久在书局'；曾公亮时为翰林学士、参知政事
modes.key_quote_zh: 大型知识工程的可靠性设计从主编架构开始——单人主编是最常见的单点故障
modes.key_quote_en: "The reliability of a great knowledge project begins with the architecture of its editors — the single chief editor is the commonest single point of failure."
process_zh: 按能力域选主编而非按职级：两位主编的专长必须互补且不重叠（军政×文翰）——同质化的双主编等于一个主编加一个影子
署名共担责任：成果与失误共同署名——共担使校验成为自利行为而非义务劳动
为主编各自配独立资源通道：一人接官方档案、一人接典籍系统——两套资料源互不依赖，内容互证
互为后备的进度设计：知识结构、体例约定文档化到对方可立即接手——后备不是名义，是可执行性
process_en: Choose editors by competence, not rank: the two chiefs' strengths must complement and not overlap — military-political by literary; homogeneous co-editors are one editor plus a shadow
Share the signature and the blame: results and faults signed together; shared burden makes verification self-interest, not charity
Give each editor an independent resource channel: one to the state archives, one to the classical system — two material sources independent, cross-verifying
Design for mutual backup: structure and conventions documented so the other can take over at once — backup not nominal but executable
representative_cases_zh: 曾丁的能力切分：曾公亮掌握边防军政第一手资料与人脉，丁度精于文字训诂与典籍校勘——《武经总要》的'军事实用'与'文本可靠'各有一个责任人
进书表的双署名：成书奏进时两人联名——图书质量作为一个共同声誉资产被绑定，任何一方的声誉都会因对方失职而受损
书局的连续运作：丁度'久在书局'，曾公亮仕途屡迁——官职流动的主编与常驻书局的专家配合，工程不因一人迁转而中断
representative_cases_en: The Zeng-Ding division: Zeng holding frontier and military-political material firsthand, Ding holding philology and textual collation — 'military usefulness' and 'textual reliability' each with an owner
The dual signature of the presentation memorial: the finished book presented in both names — quality bound as one shared reputational asset, each man's name staked on the other's diligence
The continuous office: Ding 'long in the compilation office' while Zeng's career moved him often — a mobile chief and a resident expert, the work never stopping for one man's transfer
modern_applications_zh: 大型文档/系统工程的'双负责人'设计：两个负责人的能力域互补不重叠，且互为可执行的后备——负责人单点故障在立项时就该排除
共担式署名制度：交付物署全部贡献者名字并共担质量责任——署名共担让评审的严格程度自动对齐
双资料源互证：关键结论要求来自两个独立通道（如一手数据×文献）——单一资料源的错误无人能发现
modern_applications_en: The dual-owner design for great documentation or systems: two owners of complementary, non-overlapping domains, each an executable backup of the other — single-point failure of ownership excluded at立项
Shared-signature accountability: deliverables signed by all contributors with joint quality responsibility — shared names align the rigor of review automatically
Two independent sources cross-checking: key conclusions required from two channels — primary data and literature; an error in a single source goes forever unseen

modes.name_en: The Method of the Seasoned Statesman
modes.category: 个人品格/长期任职者的稳定器角色
modes.domain_zh: 曾公亮历仕真宗、仁宗、英宗、神宗四朝四十余年，位至枢相而少有惊人之举，《宋史》评其'老成练达'——这个'没有故事'的职业生涯本身是一种治理模式：第一，跨周期任职：四朝更替、党争起伏（庆历新政、王安石变法）他都稳居要职，其立场不是骑墙，而是把'制度连续性'本身当作最高的党派；第二，关键时刻供给合法性：新君即位、变法启动这类合法性最脆弱的时刻，由他这样资历最深、争议最少的人出面背书或荐人——曾公亮荐王安石，等于把四十年的政治信用一次性注入变法；第三，以不作为储备信任：不轻易表态使他每一次表态都有分量——政治资本的利息来自稀缺；第四，退而有节：晚年请求罢相、让出位置，为权力交接预留缓冲；他证明：组织需要的不只是变革者与守成者，还需要第三种人——跨越周期的稳定器，其职能是在最需要的时刻把长期积累的信任定向释放
modes.domain_en: Zeng Gongliang served four reigns — Zhenzong, Renzong, Yingzong, Shenzong — more than forty years, rising to chief councillor with few striking deeds; the Song History calls him 'seasoned and practicable.' That storyless career is itself a mode of governance. First, office across cycles: four reigns, the tides of party strife — the Qingli New Policies, Wang Anshi's reforms — and he stood firm in high post, his position not fence-sitting but taking institutional continuity itself as his highest allegiance. Second, supplying legitimacy at the critical hour: a new reign, the launch of reform — the moments legitimacy is frailest — and the deepest-credentialed, least-contested man steps out to endorse or recommend; Zeng recommending Wang Anshi injected forty years of political credit into reform at a stroke. Third, banking trust by restraint: not speaking lightly gave weight to every time he spoke — the interest of political capital comes from scarcity. Fourth, retiring with measure: in his last years he asked to be relieved, leaving a buffer for the handover of power. He proved: an organization needs not only reformers and keepers but a third kind — the stabilizer across cycles, whose function is to release long-accumulated trust, directed, at the moment of greatest need
modes.source_chapter: 《宋史·曾公亮传》：历事四朝、'老成练达'；晚年数请罢相；《曾公亮墓志铭》（欧阳修）记其仕履
modes.key_quote_zh: 组织还需要第三种人——跨越周期的稳定器，其职能是在最需要的时刻把长期积累的信任定向释放
modes.key_quote_en: "An organization needs a third kind: the stabilizer across cycles, whose function is to release long-accumulated trust, directed, at the hour of greatest need."
process_zh: 以制度连续性为最高效忠：站队对象不是某个人物或政策，而是组织本身的延续——跨周期任职的合法性由此而来
囤积而非挥霍表态：多数议题上保持沉默或中立，把表态的次数压缩到关键节点——政治信用按稀缺计价
在最脆弱的时刻定向释放信用：新班子启动、大变革起步时出面背书或荐人——信任的释放点选在杠杆最长的位置
主动设计退场：提前请求让位、安排交接——稳定器的最后一项职责是为自己的离开做好稳定
process_en: Take institutional continuity as the highest allegiance: your side is not a man or a policy but the organization's own continuation — the legitimacy of office across cycles flows from this
Hoard speech rather than spend it: silence or neutrality on most issues, utterance compressed to the critical nodes — political credit is priced by scarcity
Release credit where the lever is longest: endorse or recommend at the launch of a new team or a great reform — the spending point chosen at maximum leverage
Design your own exit: ask early to be relieved and arrange the handover — the stabilizer's last duty is the stability of his leaving
representative_cases_zh: 荐王安石的政治信用注入：庆历新政失败后朝野对'变法'二字典信稀缺，曾公亮以四朝老臣身份力荐王安石——变法获得它靠自己挣不来的起点合法性
四朝不倒的定位术：庆历党争、王安石当国两轮剧烈动荡中稳居中枢——他的锚不是哪一派，而是'制度的连续运转'
晚年请罢：神宗朝数以老病请辞，朝廷依礼罢其相位——主动退场使后来的权力更替少了一个人为的引爆点
representative_cases_en: The credit injection of recommending Wang Anshi: after the Qingli failure, belief in 'reform' was scarce currency; the four-reign elder pressing Wang Anshi's name gave the New Policies a legitimacy they could not have earned alone
The standing of four reigns: through the Qingli strife and Wang Anshi's ascendancy he held the center — his anchor neither camp but the continuous working of the institutions
The late request for relief: under Shenzong he asked age and illness to be relieved, and was dismissed with honor — the voluntary exit removing one man-made detonator from the next succession
modern_applications_zh: 组织里设'跨周期信任岗'：识别或培养争议最少、任职最久的成员，在并购、换帅、大转型等信任真空时刻由其出面背书
表态的稀缺性管理：资深成员对多数议题保持中立，把公开立场留给真正关键的节点——逢会表态的人信用按次折旧
退场预案制度化：高管提前数月公布交接计划并陪同过渡——稳定器的价值包括把自己的离开也做成稳定事件
modern_applications_en: The seat of cross-cycle trust: identify or grow the least-contested, longest-serving members, and have them endorse at the trust vacuums — mergers, changes of chief, great pivots
Managing the scarcity of stance: senior members neutral on most issues, public positions reserved for truly critical nodes; one who opines at every meeting depreciates by the utterance
Institutionalized exit plans: executives publish handover plans months ahead and accompany the transition — the stabilizer's worth includes making his own departure a stable event

modes.name_en: The Method of Issuing to the Realm
modes.category: 方法论/知识成果的制度化分发
modes.domain_zh: 《武经总要》成书后并未止于'藏'：朝廷将其颁行武学、颁给边将、列为武举参考——一部书的生命被设计为'编成—藏于官府—颁行天下—成为标准'的完整链路；这个分发设计的深意在于：第一，受众分层：颁给边将的是边防各卷（实用），颁给武学的是全书（教材），分层分发让同一知识在不同场景达到最大可用性；第二，以颁发代替口传：过去边将的经验靠口耳相传、人走茶凉，颁行制让知识不随人员流动而流失；第三，制造引用标准：当全书成为武学与边防的官方参考，关于兵制的讨论就有了共同文本——争论从'各说各话'变为'引用同一段落'；第四，版本权威：官修颁行本天然成为定本，私抄本从此有了对照的权威源头；他证明：知识工程的最后一公里是分发设计——没有分发制度的知识资产只是仓库里的存货，有了分发制度它才成为全社会共用的基础设施
modes.domain_en: Finished, the Essentials did not stop at being kept: the court issued it to the military academy, to the border commanders, listed it for the military examinations — the book's life designed as a full chain: compiled, kept in office, issued to the realm, become the standard. The depth of the distribution design: first, audiences tiered — to border commanders the frontier scrolls (use), to the academy the whole (textbook); tiered issuing lets one knowledge serve each scene at its greatest availability. Second, issuance replacing oral transmission: a commander's experience once passed mouth to mouth and died with the man; the issuing system lets knowledge outlive the movement of persons. Third, manufacturing a standard of citation: once the book was the official reference of academy and frontier, debate on the army had a common text — argument moved from talking past each other to citing the same passage. Fourth, textual authority: the state-compiled issue became the recension, and private copies henceforth had an authoritative source to be checked against. He proved: the last mile of a knowledge project is the distribution design — without an issuing institution a knowledge asset is stock in a warehouse; with one, it becomes infrastructure shared by all
modes.source_chapter: 《武经总要》成书后'颁行'记载见《宋史》与晁公武《郡斋读书志》；南宋武举、武学以《武经总要》为课业参考；绍圣四年再颁行
modes.key_quote_zh: 知识工程的最后一公里是分发设计——没有分发制度的知识资产只是仓库里的存货，有了分发制度它才成为全社会共用的基础设施
modes.key_quote_en: "The last mile of a knowledge project is the distribution design — without an issuing institution a knowledge asset is stock in a warehouse; with one, infrastructure shared by all."
process_zh: 按受众分层设计分发：同一知识产品按使用场景切分版本（实操版/教材版/参考版）——一刀切的分发给谁都不合身
以制度通道代替人际传递：知识经由正式颁发进入组织，而非依附于具体的人——人可以走，书留下
把成果树为引用标准：推动成果成为官方/行业参考文本，让后续讨论有共同出处——共同文本是高质量争论的前提
维护版本权威：官方版本持续修订并声明权威地位，为一切私改、伪托提供对照源
process_en: Design distribution by audience tiers: one product cut into versions by use — field, textbook, reference; one-size issuing fits no one
Replace personal transmission with institutional channel: knowledge enters the organization by formal issue, not by attachment to persons — men may go; the book stays
Establish the work as the standard of citation: press it into official or industry reference status so later debate has a common source — common text precedes high-quality argument
Keep the recension authoritative: the official version revised continuously and declared canonical, the check-source for all private copies and forgeries
representative_cases_zh: 颁行边将与武学的双轨：边将得边防诸卷以实用，武学生员读全书以教育——同一部四十卷的书被切分给两种受众
绍密封四年再颁：原书颁行数十年后朝廷再次申令颁行——分发不是一次性事件，而是需要定期重申的制度
武举以总要为据：武艺考试之外增试兵法课程，参考书即《武经总要》——考试制度成为知识分发最强的强制通道
representative_cases_en: The twin track to commanders and academy: border generals got the frontier scrolls for use, the cadets the whole book for schooling — forty scrolls split across two audiences
The re-issue of Shaosheng: decades after first issue the court renewed the order — distribution not a one-time event but an institution needing periodic reassertion

The examinations citing the Essentials: beyond martial tests, the military examinations examined strategy with the Essentials as the reference — the examination system the strongest compulsory channel of distribution
modern_applications_zh: 知识产品的'分层发布'：同一份知识资产按受众出三个版本（一线速查版、培训完整版、管理层决策版）——发布即设计，而非写完就扔上wiki
以考试/认证做分发引擎：让知识资产进入组织的考核体系（认证题库、晋升标准）——考核是最强的强制分发通道
维护'定本'：对外公开的知识资产必须有声明权威的官方版本与修订日志，一切 forks 由此对照
modern_applications_en: Tiered release of knowledge assets: one asset in three versions — field quick-reference, full training, executive decision; release is design, not tossing it on the wiki when done
Examinations as the engine of distribution: put the asset into the organization's assessment system — certification banks, promotion standards; assessment is the strongest compulsory channel
Keeping the recension: public knowledge assets must have an authoritative official version with a revision log, the check-source for every fork

modes.definition_zh: 《武经总要》成书后并未止于'藏'：朝廷将其颁行武学、颁给边将、列为武举参考——一部书的生命被设计为'编成—藏于官府—颁行天下—成为标准'的完整链路；这个分发设计的深意在于：第一，受众分层：颁给边将的是边防各卷（实用），颁给武学的是全书（教材），分层分发让同一知识在不同场景达到最大可用性；第二，以颁发代替口传：过去边将的经验靠口耳相传、人走茶凉，颁行制让知识不随人员流动而流失；第三，制造引用标准：当全书成为武学与边防的官方参考，关于兵制的讨论就有了共同文本——争论从'各说各话'变为'引用同一段落'；第四，版本权威：官修颁行本天然成为定本，私抄本从此有了对照的权威源头；他证明：知识工程的最后一公里是分发设计——没有分发制度的知识资产只是仓库里的存货，有了分发制度它才成为全社会共用的基础设施
modes.definition_en: Finished, the Essentials did not stop at being kept: the court issued it to the military academy, to the border commanders, listed it for the military examinations — the book's life designed as a full chain: compiled, kept in office, issued to the realm, become the standard. The depth of the distribution design: first, audiences tiered — to border commanders the frontier scrolls (use), to the academy the whole (textbook); tiered issuing lets one knowledge serve each scene at its greatest availability. Second, issuance replacing oral transmission: a commander's experience once passed mouth to mouth and died with the man; the issuing system lets knowledge outlive the movement of persons. Third, manufacturing a standard of citation: once the book was the official reference of academy and frontier, debate on the army had a common text — argument moved from talking past each other to citing the same passage. Fourth, textual authority: the state-compiled issue became the recension, and private copies henceforth had an authoritative source to be checked against. He proved: the last mile of a knowledge project is the distribution design — without an issuing institution a knowledge asset is stock in a warehouse; with one, it becomes infrastructure shared by all
